info.text:
Mortgage rates just fell four weeks in a row. Here's the catch.
The average 30-year fixed rate is 7.11%, down from 7.18% last week (Freddie Mac, Nov 12, 2026).
It peaked at 7.40% in early October, the highest in nearly three years.
But a year ago it was 6.24%. On a $400,000 loan, that's about $231 a month more today (our math).
Sources: Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey; AP.
News and education, not financial advice.
